definitions: During the stage in a plant's life cycle when its flowers are completely open and at their absolute peak of beauty, color, and fragrance.
When a valuable potential has finally unfolded into a vibrant reality.

blocks.text: Full Bloom is the fourth Korean language studio album and the eighth overall studio album release by South Korean girl group Kara. It was released on September 2, 2013, with the song "Damaged Lady" used as the lead single. The song "Runaway" was released two weeks earlier, on August 21, as a preview for it. It is also the last Korean album to feature members Nicole Jung and Kang Ji-young who departed the group in 2014, though they would rejoin the group in 2022. The album was released one week later after the group's fourth Japanese studio album, Fantastic Girls.
Full Bloom is a live album by Acoustic Strawbs.
